verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says it lets you run applications closer to your users, which matches the core of this story. The evidence is a single one-line claim with no detail on which regions exist or how to pick one per service. Missing for 10: documentation of selectable specific regions, the mechanism for assigning a deployment to a region (dashboard, CLI or config), the list of available regions, and independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-region deployment.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy my application to specific regions closer to my users

citations.quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.
